name: Vampiric Thirst (Sp)
body:
Prerequisite: Black blade class ability or can cast vampiric touch, pool strike

Benefit: The magus can spend 1 point from her arcane pool as a free action so that the damage dealt by her pool strike grants her temporary hit points equal to the damage she deals with her pool strike. She can’t gain more than the subject’s current hit points + the subject’s Constitution score (which is enough to kill the subject). The temporary hit points disappear 1 hour later.
